llm_response.code:
import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule: No Right-Leaning Red
    (¬ is_red r) ∧
    -- Rule: No Double Red on Left (left child red AND left.left child red)
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll
     | _ => True)

-- Main Invariant
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  satisfies_red_props t

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_llrbt t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def size : Node → Nat
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r => size l + size r + 1

def paint (c : Color) : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => Node.Tree c v l r

def flipC : Color → Color
  | Color.Red => Color.Black
  | Color.Black => Color.Red

def flip_colors : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) (Node.Tree cr z d e) =>
      Node.Tree (flipC c) x (Node.Tree (flipC cl) y a b) (Node.Tree (flipC cr) z d e)
  | t => t

def rotate_left : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree _ y rl rr) => Node.Tree c y (Node.Tree Color.Red x l rl) rr
  | t => t

def rotate_right : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree _ y ll lr) r => Node.Tree c y ll (Node.Tree Color.Red x lr r)
  | t => t

def leftOf : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => l

def rightOf : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => r

def valOf : Node → Int
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ x _ _ => x

def fixL (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (rightOf t) && !is_red (leftOf t) then rotate_left t else t

def fixR (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (leftOf t) && is_red (leftOf (leftOf t)) then rotate_right t else t

def fixF (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (leftOf t) && is_red (rightOf t) then flip_colors t else t

def fix_up (t : Node) : Node := fixF (fixR (fixL t))

def mrlCore : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c x l r => flip_colors (rotate_left (Node.Tree c x l (rotate_right r)))
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty

def move_red_left (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (leftOf (rightOf (flip_colors t))) then mrlCore (flip_colors t)
  else flip_colors t

def move_red_right (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (leftOf (leftOf (flip_colors t))) then flip_colors (rotate_right (flip_colors t))
  else flip_colors t

def prepL (t : Node) : Node :=
  if (!is_red (leftOf t)) && (!is_red (leftOf (leftOf t))) then move_red_left t else t

def prepR (t : Node) : Node :=
  if (!is_red (rightOf t)) && (!is_red (leftOf (rightOf t))) then move_red_right t else t

def rebuildL (t : Node) (nl : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c x _ r => fix_up (Node.Tree c x nl r)

def rebuildRV (t : Node) (y : Int) (nr : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c _ l _ => fix_up (Node.Tree c y l nr)

def min_val : Node → Int
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ x Node.Empty _ => x
  | Node.Tree _ _ (Node.Tree c y a b) _ => min_val (Node.Tree c y a b)

def del_min : Nat → Node → Node
  | 0, t => t
  | _ + 1, Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | _ + 1, Node.Tree _ _ Node.Empty _ => Node.Empty
  | n + 1, Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl xl ll rl) r =>
      rebuildL (prepL (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl xl ll rl) r))
        (del_min n (leftOf (prepL (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl xl ll rl) r))))

def del : Nat → Node → Int → Node
  | 0, t, _ => t
  | _ + 1, Node.Empty, _ => Node.Empty
  | n + 1, Node.Tree c x l r, v =>
    if v < x then
      rebuildL (prepL (Node.Tree c x l r))
        (del n (leftOf (prepL (Node.Tree c x l r))) v)
    else
      match (if is_red l then rotate_right (Node.Tree c x l r) else Node.Tree c x l r) with
      | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
      | Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 Node.Empty =>
          if v = x1 then Node.Empty else Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 Node.Empty
      | Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 (Node.Tree cr xr lr rr) =>
          if v = valOf (prepR (Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 (Node.Tree cr xr lr rr))) then
            rebuildRV (prepR (Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 (Node.Tree cr xr lr rr)))
              (min_val (rightOf (prepR (Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 (Node.Tree cr xr lr rr)))))
              (del_min n (rightOf (prepR (Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 (Node.Tree cr xr lr rr)))))
          else
            rebuildRV (prepR (Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 (Node.Tree cr xr lr rr)))
              (valOf (prepR (Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 (Node.Tree cr xr lr rr))))
              (del n (rightOf (prepR (Node.Tree c1 x1 l1 (Node.Tree cr xr lr rr)))) v)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  paint Color.Black (del (size t + 1) (paint Color.Red t) v)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Node) (v : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_llrbt result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

@[simp] lemma is_red_empty : is_red Node.Empty = false := rfl
@[simp] lemma is_red_red (x l r) : is_red (Node.Tree Color.Red x l r) = true := rfl
@[simp] lemma is_red_black (x l r) : is_red (Node.Tree Color.Black x l r) = false := rfl

@[simp] lemma leftOf_tree (c x l r) : leftOf (Node.Tree c x l r) = l := rfl
@[simp] lemma rightOf_tree (c x l r) : rightOf (Node.Tree c x l r) = r := rfl
@[simp] lemma leftOf_empty : leftOf Node.Empty = Node.Empty := rfl
@[simp] lemma rightOf_empty : rightOf Node.Empty = Node.Empty := rfl
@[simp] lemma valOf_tree (c x l r) : valOf (Node.Tree c x l r) = x := rfl

@[simp] lemma view_empty : view Node.Empty = (∅ : Set Int) := rfl
@[simp] lemma view_tree (c x l r) :
    view (Node.Tree c x l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {x} := rfl

@[simp] lemma view_paint (c : Color) (t : Node) : view (paint c t) = view t := by
  cases t <;> rfl

@[simp] lemma view_flip (t : Node) : view (flip_colors t) = view t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x Node.Empty r => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) (Node.Tree cr z d e) => rfl

@[simp] lemma view_rotl (t : Node) : view (rotate_left t) = view t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x l Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree cr y rl rr) =>
      simp only [rotate_left, view_tree]; ext z; simp; tauto

@[simp] lemma view_rotr (t : Node) : view (rotate_right t) = view t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x Node.Empty r => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y ll lr) r =>
      simp only [rotate_right, view_tree]; ext z; simp; tauto

@[simp] lemma view_fixup (t : Node) : view (fix_up t) = view t := by
  simp only [fix_up, fixF, fixR, fixL]
  split_ifs <;> simp

@[simp] lemma view_mrl (t : Node) : view (move_red_left t) = view t := by
  simp only [move_red_left]
  split_ifs with h
  · match hh : flip_colors t with
    | Node.Empty => simp [mrlCore, ← view_flip t, hh]
    | Node.Tree c x l r =>
        have : view (flip_colors t) = view t := view_flip t
        rw [hh] at this
        simp [mrlCore, ← this]
  · simp

@[simp] lemma view_mrr (t : Node) : view (move_red_right t) = view t := by
  simp only [move_red_right]; split_ifs <;> simp

@[simp] lemma view_prepL (t : Node) : view (prepL t) = view t := by
  simp only [prepL]; split_ifs <;> simp

@[simp] lemma view_prepR (t : Node) : view (prepR t) = view t := by
  simp only [prepR]; split_ifs <;> simp

-- Tier 0: black-height infrastructure

@[simp] lemma bh_empty : black_height Node.Empty = 1 := rfl

lemma bh_tree (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) =
      if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r then
        (if c == Color.Black then black_height l + 1 else black_height l)
      else -1 := rfl

lemma is_red_iff {t : Node} : is_red t = true ↔ ∃ x l r, t = Node.Tree Color.Red x l r := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => simp
  | Tree c x l r =>
      cases c
      · simp only [is_red_red, true_iff]; exact ⟨x, l, r, rfl⟩
      · simp

-- BST lemmas

@[simp] lemma bst_flip (t : Node) : is_bst (flip_colors t) ↔ is_bst t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x Node.Empty r => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) (Node.Tree cr z d e) =>
      simp only [flip_colors, is_bst, view_tree]

lemma bst_rotl {t : Node} (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (rotate_left t) := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => exact h
  | Node.Tree c x l Node.Empty => exact h
  | Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree cr y rl rr) =>
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, ⟨h5, h6, h7, h8⟩⟩ := h
      have hxy : x < y := h3 y (by simp)
      refine ⟨?_, ⟨h1, h2, fun z hz => h3 z (by simp; tauto), h6⟩, h7, h8⟩
      intro z hz
      simp only [view_tree, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      rcases hz with (hz | hz) | hz
      · exact lt_trans (h1 z hz) hxy
      · exact h5 z hz
      · omega

lemma bst_rotr {t : Node} (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (rotate_right t) := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => exact h
  | Node.Tree c x Node.Empty r => exact h
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y ll lr) r =>
      obtain ⟨h1, ⟨h5, h6, h7, h8⟩, h3, h4⟩ := h
      have hyx : y < x := h1 y (by simp)
      refine ⟨h5, h6, ?_, fun z hz => h1 z (by simp; tauto), h8, h3, h4⟩
      intro z hz
      simp only [view_tree, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      rcases hz with (hz | hz) | hz
      · exact h7 z hz
      · exact lt_trans hyx (h3 z hz)
      · omega

lemma bst_fixup {t : Node} (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (fix_up t) := by
  simp only [fix_up, fixF, fixR, fixL]
  split_ifs <;>
    first
      | exact h
      | (rw [bst_flip]; solve_by_elim [bst_rotl, bst_rotr])
      | solve_by_elim [bst_rotl, bst_rotr]

lemma bst_mrl {t : Node} (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (move_red_left t) := by
  simp only [move_red_left]
  split_ifs with hc
  · match hh : flip_colors t with
    | Node.Empty => exact trivial
    | Node.Tree c x l r =>
        have hb : is_bst (Node.Tree c x l r) := by rw [← hh, bst_flip]; exact h
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hb
        simp only [mrlCore, bst_flip]
        refine bst_rotl ?_
        exact ⟨h1, h2, by rw [view_rotr]; exact h3, bst_rotr h4⟩
  · rwa [bst_flip]

lemma bst_mrr {t : Node} (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (move_red_right t) := by
  simp only [move_red_right]
  split_ifs
  · rw [bst_flip]; exact bst_rotr (by rwa [bst_flip])
  · rwa [bst_flip]

lemma bst_prepL {t : Node} (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (prepL t) := by
  simp only [prepL]
  split_ifs
  · exact bst_mrl h
  · exact h

lemma bst_prepR {t : Node} (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (prepR t) := by
  simp only [prepR]
  split_ifs
  · exact bst_mrr h
  · exact h

-- Tier 0 (cont.): black-height sign and root-colour lemmas

lemma bh_pos (t : Node) : black_height t = -1 ∨ 1 ≤ black_height t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty => right; norm_num
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
      rw [bh_tree]
      by_cases h : black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height l = black_height r
      · rw [if_pos h]
        have hl : 1 ≤ black_height l := ihl.resolve_left h.1
        right
        cases c <;>
          simp only [show ((Color.Red : Color) == Color.Black) = false from rfl,
            show ((Color.Black : Color) == Color.Black) = true from rfl,
            if_true, if_false] <;>
          omega
      · rw [if_neg h]; left; rfl

lemma bh_ne_neg_one_iff (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) ≠ -1 ↔
      (black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
        black_height l = black_height r) := by
  rw [bh_tree]
  by_cases h : black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height l = black_height r
  · rw [if_pos h]
    refine iff_of_true ?_ h
    have hl : 1 ≤ black_height l := (bh_pos l).resolve_left h.1
    cases c <;> simp <;> omega
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact iff_of_false (by simp) h

lemma not_is_red_iff {t : Node} :
    ¬ is_red t ↔ t = Node.Empty ∨ ∃ x l r, t = Node.Tree Color.Black x l r := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => simp
  | Tree c x l r => cases c <;> simp

-- Root recolouring: neither `is_bst` nor `satisfies_red_props` inspects the
-- root colour, and painting the root black keeps the black height finite.

lemma bst_paint (c : Color) {t : Node} (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (paint c t) := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact h
  | Tree c0 x l r => exact h

lemma rp_paint (c : Color) {t : Node} (h : satisfies_red_props t) :
    satisfies_red_props (paint c t) := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact h
  | Tree c0 x l r => exact h

lemma bh_paint_black_ne {t : Node} (h : black_height t ≠ -1) :
    black_height (paint Color.Black t) ≠ -1 := by
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      show ((1 : Int) ≠ -1)
      decide
  | Tree c x l r =>
      show black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black x l r) ≠ -1
      rw [bh_ne_neg_one_iff] at h ⊢
      exact h

lemma llrbt_paint_black {u : Node} (hb : is_bst u) (hh : black_height u ≠ -1)
    (hr : satisfies_red_props u) : is_llrbt (paint Color.Black u) :=
  ⟨bst_paint _ hb, bh_paint_black_ne hh, rp_paint _ hr⟩

-- Tier 2 (black height): shape-reduction lemmas for the rotations and the flip.

lemma rotl_tree (c cr : Color) (x y : Int) (l rl rr : Node) :
    rotate_left (Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree cr y rl rr))
      = Node.Tree c y (Node.Tree Color.Red x l rl) rr := rfl

lemma rotr_tree (c cl : Color) (x y : Int) (ll lr r : Node) :
    rotate_right (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y ll lr) r)
      = Node.Tree c y ll (Node.Tree Color.Red x lr r) := rfl

lemma flip_tree (c cl cr : Color) (x y z : Int) (a b d e : Node) :
    flip_colors (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) (Node.Tree cr z d e))
      = Node.Tree (flipC c) x (Node.Tree (flipC cl) y a b)
          (Node.Tree (flipC cr) z d e) := rfl

/-- Black height of a node whose two subtrees are already known to agree. -/
lemma bh_node_eq (c : Color) (y : Int) {a b : Node}
    (hab : black_height a = black_height b) (ha : black_height a ≠ -1) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c y a b)
      = if c == Color.Black then black_height a + 1 else black_height a := by
  rw [bh_tree, if_pos ⟨ha, by rw [← hab]; exact ha, hab⟩]

lemma bh_red_eq (y : Int) {a b : Node}
    (hab : black_height a = black_height b) (ha : black_height a ≠ -1) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red y a b) = black_height a := by
  rw [bh_node_eq Color.Red y hab ha,
    if_neg (by simp only [show ((Color.Red : Color) == Color.Black) = false from rfl]; simp)]

lemma bh_black_eq (y : Int) {a b : Node}
    (hab : black_height a = black_height b) (ha : black_height a ≠ -1) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Black y a b) = black_height a + 1 := by
  rw [bh_node_eq Color.Black y hab ha,
    if_pos (by simp only [show ((Color.Black : Color) == Color.Black) = true from rfl]; simp)]

/-- Rotating a red right child up is black-height neutral. -/
lemma bh_rotl_eq (c : Color) (x y : Int) (l rl rr : Node)
    (h : black_height (Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree Color.Red y rl rr)) ≠ -1) :
    black_height (rotate_left (Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree Color.Red y rl rr)))
      = black_height (Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree Color.Red y rl rr)) := by
  rw [bh_ne_neg_one_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨hl, hr, hlr⟩ := h
  rw [bh_ne_neg_one_iff] at hr
  obtain ⟨h1, _, h3⟩ := hr
  have e1 : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red y rl rr) = black_height rl := bh_red_eq y h3 h1
  have hlrl : black_height l = black_height rl := by rw [hlr, e1]
  have e2 : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red x l rl) = black_height l := bh_red_eq x hlrl hl
  rw [rotl_tree, bh_node_eq c y (by rw [e2, hlrl]; exact h3) (by rw [e2]; exact hl),
    bh_node_eq c x hlr hl, e2]

/-- Rotating a red left child up is black-height neutral. -/
lemma bh_rotr_eq (c : Color) (x y : Int) (ll lr r : Node)
    (h : black_height (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree Color.Red y ll lr) r) ≠ -1) :
    black_height (rotate_right (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree Color.Red y ll lr) r))
      = black_height (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree Color.Red y ll lr) r) := by
  rw [bh_ne_neg_one_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨hl, hr, hlr⟩ := h
  rw [bh_ne_neg_one_iff] at hl
  obtain ⟨h1, _, h3⟩ := hl
  have e1 : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red y ll lr) = black_height ll := bh_red_eq y h3 h1
  have hllr : black_height lr = black_height r := by rw [← h3, ← e1]; exact hlr
  have hlr' : black_height lr ≠ -1 := by rw [← h3]; exact h1
  have e2 : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red x lr r) = black_height lr := bh_red_eq x hllr hlr'
  rw [rotr_tree, bh_node_eq c y (by rw [e2, ← h3]) h1,
    bh_node_eq c x hlr (by rw [e1]; exact h1), e1]

/-- A colour flip is black-height neutral exactly when the root colour differs
from the (common) colour of the two children — the only way it is ever used. -/
lemma bh_flip_eq (c cl : Color) (x y z : Int) (a b d e : Node) (hne : c ≠ cl)
    (h : black_height (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) (Node.Tree cl z d e)) ≠ -1) :
    black_height (flip_colors (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) (Node.Tree cl z d e)))
      = black_height (Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree cl y a b) (Node.Tree cl z d e)) := by
  rw [bh_ne_neg_one_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨hl, hr, hlr⟩ := h
  rw [bh_ne_neg_one_iff] at hl hr
  obtain ⟨h1, _, h3⟩ := hl
  obtain ⟨h4, _, h6⟩ := hr
  rw [flip_tree]
  cases cl with
  | Red =>
      have hcb : c = Color.Black := by cases c; · exact absurd rfl hne; · rfl
      subst hcb
      have ead : black_height a = black_height d := by
        rw [← bh_red_eq y h3 h1, ← bh_red_eq z h6 h4]; exact hlr
      simp only [flipC]
      rw [bh_black_eq y h3 h1, bh_black_eq z h6 h4,
        bh_red_eq x (by rw [ead]) (by omega),
        bh_black_eq x (by rw [bh_red_eq y h3 h1, bh_red_eq z h6 h4]; exact hlr)
          (by rw [bh_red_eq y h3 h1]; exact h1),
        bh_red_eq y h3 h1]
      omega
  | Black =>
      have hcb : c = Color.Red := by cases c; · rfl; · exact absurd rfl hne
      subst hcb
      have ead : black_height a = black_height d := by
        have := hlr
        rw [bh_black_eq y h3 h1, bh_black_eq z h6 h4] at this
        omega
      simp only [flipC]
